values.note: $26 single site, $52 double; day use $12. Pay cash or check at the fee envelopes by the entrance.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-clear-creek-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night | Double Site: $52 per night'; 'Day Use: $12 per day'; 'Please be prepared to pay with cash or check.'; 'Fee envelopes and a collection box are provided near the entrance.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Maximum spur 40 ft; not every site fits that length. Some sites sit in sunny openings, others are shaded by small aspen, spruce and fir.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-clear-creek-campground ('has 21 sites with parking spurs'; 'Maximum spur length is 40 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Well water; central garbage cans; no firewood provided; camp host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-clear-creek-campground ('2 vault type toilets are provided and potable drinking water comes from a well'; 'Garbage cans are centrally located. values.note: Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend (2026 opening May 22).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-clear-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day Weekend.'; 'Concessionaire operations for 2026 season will begin May 22nd.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Senior and Access passes: 50% off a single campsite, only the site the pass holder occupies.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/north-clear-creek-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Rio Grande NF (Divide Ranger District) concessionaire campground ~2.1 mi north on FR 510 off CO-149, about 24.5 mi west of Creede, ~9,900 ft. Hidden from the road, beside North Clear Creek (fishing; firsthand reviews put sites ~50 yd from the creek, not on the bank); quiet and well away from towns, with fall aspen color and moose. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 21 sites, $26, FCFS only, vault toilets, well water, no hookups (stored, unchanged). Added max spur 40 ft, $52 double/day-use, 14-day limit, season Memorial Day-Labor Day note, senior/access 50%. Note trimmed of field facts.
